Game Overview

In Speed Racer, the core idea is straightforward: tear up the asphalt in Speed Racer, where you dodge obstacles and outsmart the cops in "Loop" mode or dominate the competition in heart-pounding 1vs1 races. Unlock over 50 unique vehicles as you navigate an ever-evolving, vibrant world of high-speed adventure and relentless challenges.
